site.name: Vivienda 2026: RDL 29/2026 y RDL 28/2026
site.description: Reading guide on Spanish 2026 housing decree-laws. RDL 29/2026 in force since 2026-10-08 (pending convalidation); RDL 28/2026 not yet in force; RDL 26/2026 and 27/2026 repealed 2026-10-02. No agent payments or authentication.

webmcp.description: Status, key figures, timeline, FAQs and the nine read-only WebMCP tools (includes get_concordance).
Evictions, LAU reform and the indefinite extension with compensation.
Income tax, VAT, property tax, SOCIMIs and land value tax.
Public housing stock, guarantees, TU CASA loans and the Financia Europa account (art. 21 RDL 29).
